title: scene-00: avatar id=userId collides across regions
description: draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00.md:551 SHOULD use userId as SceneAvatar id 'within a given region'. JMAP ids are unique per type per account, and avatars are never destroyed, so one user visiting regions A and B needs two records with the same id. Id syntax (user:alice@... violates RFC 8620 1.2) is tracked in jmap-chat-spec-pcoc; this bead is the collision/scoping problem.
close_reason: Fixed in scene-00/scene-wss per 2026-10-20 decisions; log scratchpad/audit/scene00-fix.md and scenewss-fix.md; guides synced.
